title: 09. Backend Python: CODE QUALITY TOOLS
summary: CODE QUALITY TOOLS: explanations and runnable examples.

sections.title: Introduction
sections.body:
```python name=tools/code_quality.py
# ============================================================
# CODE QUALITY — Tools Every Python Dev Must Use
# ============================================================

# --- 1. Ruff (Fastest linter + formatter, replaces flake8/isort/black) ---
# pip install ruff
# ruff check .                    # Lint
# ruff check . --fix              # Auto-fix
# ruff format .                   # Format (like black)

# pyproject.toml config:
"""
[tool.ruff]
line-length = 100
target-version = "py312"

[tool.ruff.lint]
select = ["E", "F", "I", "N", "W", "UP", "B", "SIM", "C4"]
"""

# --- 2. mypy (Static type checker) ---
# pip install mypy
# mypy app/                       # Check types
# mypy --strict app/              # Strict mode

# pyproject.toml:
"""
[tool.mypy]
python_version = "3.12"
strict = true
warn_return_any = true
"""

# --- 3. pytest (Testing) ---
# pip install pytest pytest-cov pytest-asyncio
# pytest                          # Run all tests
# pytest -v                       # Verbose
# pytest --cov=app                # With coverage
# pytest -x                       # Stop on first failure
# pytest -k "test_user"           # Run matching tests

# --- 4. pre-commit hooks ---
# pip install pre-commit
# .pre-commit-config.yaml:
"""
repos:
  - repo: https://github.com/astral-sh/ruff-pre-commit
    rev: v0.5.0
    hooks:
      - id: ruff
        args: [--fix]
      - id: ruff-format
  - repo: https://github.com/pre-commit/mirrors-mypy
    rev: v1.10.0
    hooks:
      - id: mypy
"""

# pre-commit install              # Install hooks
# pre-commit run --all-files      # Run manually
```
